name: Worker
description: Economic unit. Gathers wood, food and gold (carries 10 per trip and drops it at the Town Center), builds every building, plants and harvests farms, works inside a Mine and extinguishes fires. Very weak in combat; keep workers away from enemy soldiers.

name: Spearman
description: Low-cost anti-cavalry melee infantry. Deals double (2x) damage to Cavalry (Tank in Sci-Fi mode). Loses to Archers, which outrange it. Best answer when the enemy shows many Cavalry.

name: Archer
description: Ranged infantry with attack range 5. Deals double (2x) damage to Spearmen (Marines in Sci-Fi). Fragile (50 HP) and countered by fast Cavalry. In Medieval mode only Archers can attack an enemy Archer Tower, and an Archer is the unit that mans your own Archer Tower.

name: Cavalry
description: Fast, durable melee unit (speed 4.5, 100 HP). Deals double (2x) damage to Archers (Snipers in Sci-Fi). Countered by Spearmen. Needs a Stable (Vehicle Bay in Sci-Fi) and gold. In Sci-Fi mode the Tank also fires rockets (2x damage, range 5, reload 2.5 s) and is the only unit that can attack an enemy Rocket Turret.
